licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets map cleanly onto the dominant recurring themes across states: fraud/deceit in obtaining or exercising a license; criminal convictions; substandard clinical care (negligence, malpractice, incompetence); substance abuse impairing practice; physical/mental incapacity; employing or enabling unlicensed persons; false or misleading advertising; improper fee arrangements (splitting, kickbacks, overbilling); and catch-all regulatory/administrative violations (statute violations, board orders, reporting failures, continuing education).

profession_specific.laser_procedures_aut.rationale: These eight buckets capture the distinct clinical procedure clusters visible in the data: the two most common named procedures (capsulotomy, trabeculoplasty), iridotomy as its own cluster, refractive/corneal laser, diagnostic-only authorizations, broad therapeutic laser grants, non-laser light therapies (IPL/LLLT), and catch-all 'authorized except X' broad-scope grants.

profession_specific.minor_surgical_proce.rationale: These nine buckets map cleanly onto the anatomical and procedural clusters visible in the data: foreign body extraction, corneal scraping/debridement/puncture, epilation of lashes, lacrimal dilation/irrigation/plug work, all injection types (anesthetic, steroid, botulinum, epinephrine), excision/curettage of chalazia and skin lesions, eyelid laceration repair and abscess drainage, IPL/nonlaser light therapies, and a small residual bucket for miscellaneous items (blood collection, suture removal, biologic membranes, corneal shaping).

profession_specific.controlled_substance.rationale: The data clusters around: blanket Schedule I bans, blanket Schedule II bans, carve-outs permitting hydrocodone/combination products within Schedule II, conditional permission of lower schedules (III–V) with quantity or indication limits, explicit day-supply caps (72-hour, 3-day, 5-day) that cross schedule lines, exclusions of non-controlled systemic drug classes (antifungals, immunosuppressives, antimetabolites, steroids, injectables), and bare statutory section citations that carry no descriptive content of their own.
